jobs.title: Senior Director, Strategy & Offer, Personal Wealth
jobs.description:
About the role

We are looking for a senior leader to provide strategy expertise in support of Vanguard’s mission, clients, products and crew. As Senior Director Strategy & Offer, Personal Wealth, you will be a critical leader helping to shape the strategy and offers for Personal Wealth.

Personal Wealth is Vanguard’s unified division focused on delivering exceptional experiences for individual investors across every stage of their financial journey. Organized around distinct client segments, the division brings together the strengths of Vanguard’s Personal Investor and Wealth Management models to provide focused advice, innovative solutions, and scalable personalization.

Through segment-specific distribution, specialized advice and wealth capabilities, and a strong emphasis on digital and client experience transformation, Personal Wealth is designed to meet evolving client needs with both human insight and advanced technology. Our teams work collaboratively to simplify how we operate, accelerate execution, and deliver industry-leading outcomes for millions of investors.

This is a high-visibility role that will materially shape Personal Wealth’s strategy as we build it out this year and beyond — with direct exposure to Personal Wealth leadership and across the broader organization.

Core Responsibilities

- Lead complex, high-impact strategic, competitive, and product analyses; partner with senior leaders to define business problems, shape analytical approaches, and guide execution

- Drive business and offer projects and help set the strategy; leverage team insights and manage internal partnerships to deliver against service expectations

- Translate complex analyses into clear, actionable recommendations; prepare and present strategic insights to senior executives through presentations, written materials, and briefings

- Provide thought leadership on priority strategic topics; evolve strategy frameworks and analytical approaches to strengthen enterprise decision-making

- Analyze and interpret complex data to generate meaningful insights; ensure data quality and craft compelling narratives aligned to executive priorities

- Monitor industry, market, and competitive trends in collaboration with the competitive intelligence function; recommend new capabilities and solutions and advise business leaders on emerging opportunities and risks

- Lead or contribute to enterprise initiatives and special projects as needed

- Build, lead, and develop high-performing teams; set clear performance expectations, provide coaching, and make compensation decisions in alignment with company policy

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required; Master’s degree preferred

- 8+ years of experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, or financial analysis, ideally with a top-tier consulting firm

- Demonstrated strategic judgment in highly ambiguous environments, with strength in framing complex problems and driving sound executive decisions

- Proven ability to independently lead large-scale, high-impact strategic initiatives from concept through execution

- Executive presence with the ability to influence without authority — crafting clear strategic narratives, aligning senior stakeholders, and driving outcomes

- Strong people and talent leadership, with accountability for building, developing, and sustaining high-performing teams

- Exceptional communication skills, including executive-level presentations and decision materials

- Strong commercial mindset with disciplined project execution, prioritization, and results ownership

Special Factors
Sponsorship
Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position.

jobs.title: Senior Strategy Manager, Money Movement
jobs.description:
This role serves as a strategic connector between Product, Operations, Fraud, Risk, Compliance, Technology, and Client Experience teams to ensure Cash Plus and Brokerage money movement capabilities are delivered through a unified and client-centric approach. The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical capabilities, organizational effectiveness, and stakeholder influence to translate strategic priorities into actionable execution plans that improve client outcomes and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Program Execution & Governance

- Lead requirements gathering, dependency management, and execution planning for strategic money movement initiatives.
- Identify and track key decisions, risks, milestones, and action items across multiple initiatives and stakeholder groups.
- Develop and deliver executive-level updates, business cases, recommendations, and supporting analyses to facilitate informed decision-making.
- Hold stakeholders accountable to commitments, timelines, and agreed-upon outcomes while fostering strong cross-functional partnerships.

Ecosystem Orchestration & Roadmap Alignment
- Drive coordination across Fraud, Operations, CXD, Product, Technology, and servicing teams to align strategic priorities and execution plans.
- Facilitate decision-making processes that bring together diverse stakeholder perspectives and drive progress toward shared outcomes.
- Translate strategic objectives into sequenced initiatives, actionable plans, and measurable deliverables.
- Identify and resolve gaps, overlaps, and conflicting priorities across programs and workstreams.

Money Movement Strategy & Client Experience
- Identify opportunities to reduce money movement friction and improve the end-to-end client experience across funding, transfers, withdrawals, and payment journeys.
- Analyze existing policies, limits, and servicing practices to recommend enhancements that balance client experience, risk management, and operational efficiency.
- Lead modernization of money movement policies and controls to align with evolving client expectations and industry capabilities.
- Evaluate emerging trends, client feedback, and operational insights to inform strategic recommendations and roadmap priorities.

Fraud & Risk Ecosystem Integration
- Lead evaluations alongside Fraud, Risk, Compliance, and Product teams to assess the impact of new fraud detection and prevention capabilities on the money movement experience.
- Support the integration of new fraud vendors and controls into existing product, operational, and policy frameworks.
- Evaluate trade-offs between risk mitigation and client experience and identify solutions that support enterprise objectives.
- Identify and lead resolution of dependencies and program-level decisions, balancing operational impacts associated with fraud and risk initiatives.

Vendor Strategy & Capability Implementation
- Lead vendor analysis coordinating across Product, Operations, Technology, Fraud, Risk, Compliance, and Client Experience teams to ensure successful identification and deployment of vendor-driven capabilities.
- Drive solution implementation, managing  dependencies, and operational readiness activities.

Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in product strategy, payments, money movement, financial services, operations, consulting, or program management.
- Strong understanding of money movement ecosystems, including ACH, transfers, fraud controls, payment operations, and client servicing processes.
- Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives involving Product, Operations, Fraud, Risk, Compliance, and Technology teams.
- Proven ability to influence and drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in fraud prevention, money movement, banking, payments, or wealth management.
- Knowledge of regulatory and compliance considerations related to money movement activities.
- NACHA certification or related payments expertise preferred.

- Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of training and experience. Graduate degree preferred.

If you require any additional information or have questions, please reach out to Brandon King or Joe Stafford.

jobs.title: Marketing Program Manager, Personal Wealth
jobs.description:
HyperP is entering an exciting new phase of growth, and we're looking for a Program Manager to help shape the future of personalized marketing at Vanguard. Sitting at the intersection of marketing, technology, and analytics, you'll bring together strategy and execution to scale HyperP's capabilities, drive cross-functional alignment, and deliver seamless client experiences at enterprise scale. This is a highly visible role for someone who is highly versatile, influences across teams, and turns data-driven insights into measurable business impact.

HyperP uses a cross-functional operating model that brings together Engagement Strategy, Product, Technology, Activation, Analytics, and Marketing to deliver personalized client experiences at scale. As Personal Wealth Marketing shifts from managing HyperP execution to driving scalable, measurable transformation, the HyperP Program Manager will strengthen accountability, standardize prioritization, and improve delivery efficiency.

The ideal candidate is action- and solution-oriented, influential across broad stakeholder groups, and able to move seamlessly between tactical execution and strategic thinking. They translate data and insights into actionable recommendations that improve process, adoption, and performance.

This role carries a high level of technical and cross-functional complexity, with oversight of end-to-end HyperP delivery and integration into BAU processes and workflows.
- Embed connected client journeys into BAU workflows to deliver seamless end-to-end experiences.

- Scale delivery by improving throughput, readiness tracking, and milestone/dependency management.

- Reinforce accountability through clear SLAs, deliverables, timelines, and operating cadences.

- Coordinate across Marketing, Technology, Analytics, PI, and other cross-functional partners as complexity increases.

- Communicate across tactical and strategic forums, including BRP and planning sessions.

- Proactively manage risks, remove blockers, and maintain delivery momentum.

- Act as a connector across teams, using a consultative, solution-oriented approach to drive outcomes.

Responsibilities
- Align directly to the HyperP core team, enabling operations and end-to-end integration of personalized client experiences across marketing, technology, and cross-functional delivery.

- Partner with Personal Wealth Marketing, Business Owners, Marketing, and Engagement Strategy to prioritize the client journey roadmap and coordinate with Data Analytics, CXD, PI Tech, PWM teams, and channel partners.

- Key areas of focus include:

- Operations: Coordinate intake, tranche planning, requirements, go/no-go decisioning, artifact maintenance, dependency management, stakeholder connections, and adoption of HyperP capabilities, tools, and standardized processes.

- Planning: Facilitate quarterly BRP planning, mid-quarter performance check-ins, prioritization and decision-making, monthly insights and capacity forecasting, and weekly progression meetings.

- Communications: Build awareness of HyperP tools, requirements, processes, and best practices; elevate program communications, manage the monthly newsletter, and support Executive SteerCo and stakeholder alignment forums.

- Process: Evolve the HyperP operating model by reimagining processes, standardizing meeting cadence and structure, and improving measurement.

- Serve as a strategic connector across teams to align priorities, clarify decision rights, and accelerate execution.

- Influence without direct authority by building trust, credibility, shared ownership, and strong facilitation practices.

- Translate data, stakeholder feedback, and pilot learnings into actionable recommendations aligned to company strategy and market conditions.

- Build leader relationships across PWM, foster stakeholder communication, and influence key cross-functional decisions.

- Proactively identify, manage, and mitigate risks and issues; communicate solutions and secure stakeholder input and buy-in.

Operational Readiness
- Teams are prepared to launch and support new capabilities.
- Release plans, support models, and readiness activities are coordinated to ensure a smooth transition to BAU operations.

jobs.title: Business Transformation and Change Management Lead, Specialist
jobs.description:
About Vanguard
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.

Vanguard India
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.

Role Summary
This role leads to business transformation and/or major change management initiatives, applying functional expertise to drive results.

This role applies structured methodologies and assessment techniques to ensure effective adoption while minimizing operational disruptions and driving continuous improvement within IT and business environments.

Responsibilities
- Develops, implements, monitors master change and communication plans for large departmental or multi-year initiatives and programs. Contributes expertise and leads a business engagement plan, including ways of assessing readiness and feedback. Secures senior management buy-in across the department/division.
- Provides insight into the best practices and common obstacles based on prior change management experiences. Serves as a trusted advisor to ensure business transformation and/or change initiatives are aligned with the overall company strategy and market conditions.
- Communicates business transformation and change management status and issues regularly to stakeholders, including leaders, team members, and senior managers.
- Builds and maintains effective relationships. Proactively fosters communication between internal and external stakeholders. Influences key decisions across stakeholder groups.
- Proactively identifies, manages, and mitigates risks and any related issues. Communicates solutions on key issues or projects to management and stakeholders to obtain their input and buy-in as appropriate.
- Develop measurement processes for change management success that help business partners do self-assessments based on communicated maturity models.
- Builds and maintains productive working relationships with various project team members, consultants and stakeholders at both the executive and operational level.
- Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
- Plans and executives change management and process improvement projects across the IT organization.
- Applies methodologies such as communication planning, organizational readiness assessments, and stakeholder analysis to support change adoption.
- Monitors implementation to ensure minimal disruption to normal business operations.
- Acts as a change agent to drive and embed best practices and continuous improvement in IT systems and processes.
- Maintains working knowledge of business processes to identify when software or system changes should be initiated.

Qualifications and Skills
- Minimum 8 years of experience in business transformation, change management, or process improvement initiatives. At least three years of hands-on experience in change and communication planning within large-scale transformation programs.
- Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech/BBA/BA) or equivalent combination of education and experience required; graduate degree (MBA or MTech) preferred.
- Good skills to have include change management methodologies (e.g., ADKAR, Kotter), stakeholder engagement, communication planning, organizational readiness assessment, risk mitigation, and metrics-based success evaluation. Strong interpersonal, facilitation, and executive communication skills are essential, along with cross-functional collaboration and influencing without authority.
- Experience with IT transformation projects and tools like Prosci, Jira, ServiceNow, or similar change tracking systems is a plus.
- Preferred certifications: Prosci Change Management, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or ITIL Foundation.
- Ability to operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, acting as a strategic partner to leadership and a tactical guide to project teams

Location
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.

Our mission
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

Our commitment to you
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:

Financial wellness
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.

Physical wellness
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.

Personal wellness
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.

How we work
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

jobs.title: Associate Investment Product Management & Governance Specialist
jobs.description:
The Role
The Product Management and Governance (PMG) team plays a critical role in shaping and overseeing Vanguard Europe’s fund range, ensuring that our products continue to deliver strong client outcomes while meeting evolving regulatory and market expectations.

This role offers the opportunity to work at the centre of Vanguard’s product organisation, partnering with senior stakeholders across Investments, Risk, Legal, Distribution and Operations to influence the strategic direction, governance and evolution of our European fund range.

In this role you will
- Product governance and fund oversight : manages key elements of the product governance framework for Vanguard Europe funds, ensuring robust oversight across performance, risk, compliance, costs, and client outcomes. Supports engagement with Fund Boards, management companies, and governance committees on matters relating to existing funds, partnering closely with Company Secretariat on board materials and decision support. Helps ensure fund governance activities meet regulatory expectations across relevant European and other international UCITS jurisdictions
- Ongoing fund management and fund health : drives the ongoing management of existing fund ranges, supporting clear accountability for fund health, sustainability, and client value. Leads the identification, assessment, and remediation of fund health issues, including underperformance, scale challenges, or structural concerns. Coordinates fund closure activity where required, ensuring controlled execution and strong client and regulatory outcomes
- Assessments of Value and Fund Value Assessments: manages the delivery and governance of Assessments of Value and Fund Value Assessments across the European fund range. Ensures assessments are analytically robust, client-focused, and clearly articulated for Boards and senior stakeholders. Drives actions arising from AoV and FVA outcomes and ensures progress is tracked and evidenced
- Regulatory change delivery: s upports regulatory change impacting existing funds, including impact assessment, solution design, and delivery through to implementation. Partners with Legal, Compliance, Regulatory Operations, Risk, and Investments to help ensure requirements are interpreted consistently and implemented effectively. Helps ensure regulatory-driven fund changes are prioritised appropriately and delivered in a controlled and timely manner
- Fund changes, amendments and structural evolution: leads research, analysis, coordination, and governance support for material fund changes, including benchmark changes, fee changes, investment objective updates, and structural amendments. Ensures proposed changes are supported by clear rationale, robust analysis, and appropriate governance approvals. Balances regulatory, commercial, and client considerations in shaping recommendations
- Stakeholder partnership and influence: partners with Investments, Distribution, Marketing, Operations, Risk, and Legal on matters relating to existing funds and product governance. Provides clear, balanced recommendations grounded in client outcomes, regulatory requirements, and commercial insight
- Enterprise contribution: contributes to enterprise-wide initiatives, cross-functional programs, and special projects as required. Shares best practice across PRD and supports continuous improvement in governance processes, controls, and reporting

- Representation and cross-functional coordination: Serves as a key PRD representative in the Dublin office, building strong local connections and coordinating across functions to align priorities, facilitate effective discussion and support the delivery of PRD initiatives

What it takes
- Experience in product governance, product management, fund oversight, asset management, investment operations, risk, regulatory change or a related discipline within financial services
- Knowledge of investment products and fund structures, ideally within UCITS or other regulated fund environments
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex information and translate insights into clear recommendations and actions
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with confidence engaging and influencing colleagues across multiple functions and levels of seniority
- Ability to manage multiple priorities, navigate ambiguity and deliver high-quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment
- A collaborative mindset, intellectual curiosity and a passion for improving client outcomes
- Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
- CFA, IMC or other relevant investment or professional qualification preferred

Special Factors
- Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position
- This is a hybrid position and would require you to work in the office 3 days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday)

- Please note that, although we offer hybrid working, all work must be performed within the Republic of Ireland to ensure compliance with tax requirements and to mitigate the risks associated with working outside your country of employment.  If you are not able to work fully from the Republic of Ireland, please notify the recruiter

- Please note that we review applications on a rolling basis and may close this role early if there is a high level of interest. To avoid missing out, we recommend applying as soon as possible

Why Vanguard?
Vanguard is a different kind of investment company. It was founded in the United States in 1975 on a simple but revolutionary idea: that an investment company should manage its funds solely in the interests of its clients.

This is a philosophy that has helped millions of people around the world to achieve their goals with low-cost, uncomplicated investments.
It's what we stand for: value to investors.

jobs.title: Active Municipal Investment Analyst
jobs.description:
Vanguard is seeking an Active Municipal Investment Analyst to join its Municipal Fixed Income Research team. This position offers the opportunity to develop municipal credit research and investment expertise through a collaborative apprenticeship model, working alongside experienced investors at the largest institutional municipal fixed income investment manager.

Supporting senior analysts, the Investment Analyst will conduct fundamental credit research, evaluate investment opportunities, and translate issuer-level analysis into clear credit opinions, relative value assessments, and actionable investment insights across investment-grade and high-yield municipal credits. The analyst will collaborate closely with portfolio managers and traders to develop and implement investment strategies.

The successful candidate will bring intellectual curiosity, sound analytical judgment, an interest in financial markets, and the ability to form and communicate investment views in an evolving market environment.

In this role, you will

- Conduct fundamental credit research on municipal issuers across assigned sectors, regions, and areas of coverage.
- Support senior analysts in evaluating credits, maintaining issuer coverage, and developing investment perspectives.
- Develop and contribute to internal credit ratings, credit outlooks, investment theses, relative value assessments, and investment strategy recommendations.
- Translate research findings into timely, actionable insights for senior analysts, portfolio managers, traders, and other investment stakeholders.
- Present credit opinions, research findings, and investment views in team discussions, portfolio reviews, and other investment forums.

- Analyze audited financial statements, budgets, operating performance, revenue trends, debt profiles, capital plans, liquidity, leverage, debt-service coverage, pension obligations, and other long-term liabilities.

- Build and maintain financial models, bond payment schedules, scenario analyses, and stress tests to evaluate the relationship between operating performance and credit quality.

- Respond to research and fixed income desk inquiries and provide analysis supporting portfolio and investment decisions.
- Monitor economic, demographic, political, regulatory, and public-policy developments that may affect individual issuers or municipal sectors.
- Contribute to special projects and initiatives that enhance the team’s research capabilities, analytical tools, data quality, and investment processes.

We recognize that strong candidates can bring different combinations of experience and skills, and we encourage applicants who are excited about the role and interested in developing as investors to apply.

Qualifications
Required

- Undergraduate degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and professional experience.
- Experience in financial services, public finance, investment research, or another analytical field that demonstrates transferable skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present analytical findings and views clearly.
- Ability to work collaboratively with senior analysts, portfolio managers, traders, and other investment professionals.
- Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and commitment to maintaining accurate, high-quality research and financial data.

Preferred

- Experience or exposure to investment management, financial markets, public finance, or related fields.
- Interest in or progress toward the Chartered Financial Analyst designation or other relevant financial certification.
- Exposure to Python, R, or comparable analytical and data-development tools.

What Will Help You Succeed

- A genuine passion for markets and an interest in developing a career in fixed income investing.
- A curious and independent mindset, balanced with the ability to contribute effectively within a collaborative, team-based investment process.
- Willingness to develop and communicate analytical conclusions while remaining open to alternative viewpoints and new information.
- Interest in developing sound investment judgment and forming well-supported views when information is incomplete or market conditions are ambiguous.

Special Factors

jobs.title: Senior Quantitative MBS Research Analyst
jobs.description:
Join Vanguard’s Fixed Income team as a Senior Quantitative MBS Research Analyst, where your quantitative expertise, market knowledge, and ability to translate complex data into actionable insights will directly influence investment outcomes across multiple active funds at Vanguard. In this role, you’ll partner closely with portfolio management and trading teams to enhance fixed income decision-making, explore innovative techniques such as machine learning and alternative data, and help shape strategies that seek to generate excess returns across various agency residential (MBS) and commercial mortgage-backed securities (ACMBS). This is an opportunity for a thoughtful, analytical professional to make a meaningful impact within a mission-driven investment organization known for putting long-term client success at the center of everything we do.

- Knowledge of capital markets and investment concepts. Knowledge of Agency MBS preferred.

jobs.description:
Vanguard is a business that operates on trust – trust that we focus on the client, trust that assets are safe from fraud, and trust that we employ intelligent, ethical, and informed crew. That’s why we hire best-in-class financial minds to conduct thorough research and recommend the right course of action. Vanguard is currently seeking one such expert to partner with our businesses.

Vanguard’s Financial Analysts provide consultative support to our internal clients by preparing analyses and models that allow them to make the right strategic decisions. In this role, you’ll collaborate with senior leaders to understand their business’ financial needs and aid in the annual planning process. In this role, you’ll be an integral part of the business landscape and a steward of Vanguard’s success.

Is able to create new ways to analyze/solve/discuss the most difficult problems/challenges faced by their clients.
